GOP Senator Seeks Investigation into Trump Jr. Wedding Costs

Republican Senator Chuck Grassley has requested the Senate Judiciary Committee subpoena Donald Trump Jr. and Hunter Biden. This call for investigation follows a report that a Russian oligarch, identified as a Putin ally, helped cover the costs of renting a private island in the Bahamas for Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding to Bettina Anderson. The report also stated that the oligarch helped pay for the wedding event itself.
